title: Threat Actor <-> Motivation
prompt: Classify each profile into the most likely threat actor category.

items.label: Ransomware campaign with ransom demand and resale of stolen data
Destructive attack intended to cause panic and paralyze a public service
Using a script found online without technical understanding, to gain notoriety
Website defacement to protest an environmental policy
Disgruntled employee who exfiltrates data after being denied a promotion
Accountant who enters the wrong email address and sends a confidential file to the wrong recipient
Theft of research blueprints before a rival product launch
Long-term campaign with custom tools, zero-days, and strategic intelligence objectives
Scam via spoofed executive email requesting a wire transfer
Administrator who modifies access permissions to benefit a rival company

explain: Classify by motivation and attributes: legitimate access (insider/accidental), financial gain (organized crime/competitor), ideological cause (hacktivist/terrorist), and resources/sophistication (nation-state actor). The tool used does not define the category.
